topic: Parts and Functions of Nose and Tongue
key_concepts: The nose is the sense organ for smelling and breathing
The nose has nostrils, nasal cavity, and nerves
Nostrils are the two openings of the nose
Nose hairs filter dust from inhaled air
The nasal cavity is the space behind the nose
Mucus traps dust, dirt, and germs
Nerves in the nasal cavity detect scents and send messages to the brain
The tongue is the sense organ for tasting
Taste buds are embedded in the tongue
Taste buds detect sweet, sour, salty, and bitter tastes
Nerves send taste messages to the brain
Smell and taste work together, so colds reduce flavor
